fusions.name: Decree Bolt
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 30 damage. Your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds after it hits.

fusions.name: Gavel Rap
fusions.desc: A rap that deals 16 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hush Order
fusions.desc: Veils you and up to 4 allies within 5 tiles for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Commanding Stare
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.
